actions.create_message.description: Schedules or immediately publishes a post to one or more social media profiles.
actions.create_message.props.emailNotifi: Send an email notification when the post is published.
actions.create_message.props.scheduledSe: When to publish the post (UTC, must be at least 5 minutes in the future). Leave empty to post immediately.
actions.create_message.props.socialProfi: Select the social media profiles to post to.
actions.create_message.props.text.descri: The text content of your post.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_message.description: Permanently deletes a post. Only posts in a deletable state (e.g. SCHEDULED) can be removed.
actions.delete_message.props.messageId.d: The unique ID of the post to delete. You can get this from the "Schedule Post" or "Get Post Details" action.
actions.get_message.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduled or published post by its ID.
actions.get_message.props.messageId.desc: The unique ID of the post. You can get this from a previous "Schedule Post" action output or from the Hootsuite dashboard URL.
auth.description: Connect your Hootsuite account. Create an OAuth2 app and get your client credentials at https://developer.hootsuite.com.
description: Social media management — schedule posts and manage multiple networks from one dashboard.
triggers.new_published_post.description: Triggers when a post is published (sent) in Hootsuite.
triggers.new_scheduled_post.description: Triggers when a new post is scheduled in Hootsuite.
